questions.question: Practical station: BacT (Powerpoint) isolate - GNB, oxidase negative, catalase positive. Shown BAP, OF glucose positive, DNAase positive.

parts.text: Name 4 genera that are yellow-pigmented non-fermenters.

questions.model_answer:
a) Organism: Stenotrophomonas maltophilia (oxidase-negative, catalase-positive, glucose-oxidizing/OF-glucose-positive nonfermenter — DNase positivity is a key distinguishing feature from most other glucose-nonfermenting GNB).
b) Four yellow-pigmented nonfermenter genera: Chryseobacterium, Elizabethkingia, Sphingobacterium, Flavobacterium.
questions.beyond_mandell: Stenotrophomonas maltophilia identification is standard clinical microbiology teaching (oxidase-negative, DNase-positive nonfermenter) and is covered in Mandell's Pseudomonas/nonfermenter chapter rather than this 'Other GN Bacilli' chapter.

questions.question: Q61 (2018). Antibacterial Mechanism of Resistance. Aeromonas hydrophila organism with the following susceptibilities: Ampicillin (R), Ceftriaxone (R), Aztreonam (R), Meropenem (R), Ertapenem (R), Tigecycline (S)

parts.text: a) The organism possesses a carbapenemase which was inactivated by EDTA. Which class of carbapenems is represented here?
b) Name one other gram negative found in this same class of beta-lactamases
c) Name two other mechanisms (non-carbapenemase) that can cause carbapenem resistance?

cohort_answer.text: Ambler Class B: MBL. Other GNB in this class: Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Stenotrophomonas maltophilia (also E. coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Enterobacter cloacae). Other mechanisms: decrease or loss of porin (OprD) and increased efflux pump (MexXY)

questions.question: What is the most likely bug in the following scenarios?

parts.text: Scalp wound cellulitis from fresh water
CA patient with bullous skin lesions and Gram stain showing GPBs

cohort_answer.text: 1) Capnocytophaga canimorsus. 2) Aeromonas. Others: Burkholderia, Edwardsiella, Plesiomonas, Pseudomonas. Salt water: Vibrio, Shewanella, Erysipelothrix. 3) Giardia. 4) Clostridium septicum (w/o trauma), due to the malignancy

questions.question: PM 14. What is the most likely organism to the species level in the following situations? AML with CVC and hemorrhagic bullae with GPB? (1); Fresh water exposure and necrotizing scalp cellulitis (1); CVID on interferon gamma with bloating and diarrhea (1); Post splenectomy patient who gets sepsis following a dog bite (1)

parts.text: AML with CVC and hemorrhagic bullae with GPB?
Fresh water exposure and necrotizing scalp cellulitis
CVID on interferon gamma with bloating and diarrhea
Post splenectomy patient who gets sepsis following a dog bite

cohort_answer.text: Clostridium septicum (in immunocompromised can cause gas gangrene without trauma, differentiating from C. perfringens; translocates from GI to hematogenous spread to skin; associated with colorectal CA). Aeromonas hydrophila (fresh water). Giardia lamblia/duodenalis. Capnocytophaga canimorsus.
